name: Belmond Villa San Michele
insider_take: This 15th-century former monastery perched on the hillsides of Fiesole offers breathtaking panoramic views of Florence's Renaissance skyline, just 20 minutes from the city center.
whats_special: The hotel's façade is attributed to Michelangelo himself, and the property features original frescoed ceilings, loggia dining with valley views, and terraced gardens filled with centuries-old olive trees. The heated outdoor pool seems to float above the Tuscan countryside.
pro_tip: Book a sunset aperitivo on the terrace during golden hour - the view of Florence's Duomo and Ponte Vecchio bathed in warm light is absolutely magical and perfect for photos.
dont_miss: The hotel's cooking school in a restored 16th-century villa, where you can learn traditional Tuscan recipes using herbs from their own garden. Also explore nearby Fiesole's Roman amphitheater and archaeological museum, both within walking distance.
pros: Historic 15th-century monastery with stunning Renaissance architecture
Breathtaking panoramic views of Florence and the Tuscan hills
Luxurious spa and wellness facilities in serene garden setting
Michelin-starred dining with exceptional Italian cuisine
Intimate boutique property with personalized luxury service
cons: Hillside location requires transportation to reach Florence city center
